jobs.title: Director, Go-to-Market , Professional Services
jobs.description_text:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Director of Go-to-Market (GTM) for Professional Services (PS) to shape and scale how our Professional Services organization drives adoption of the ELERA software platform and its enabling professional services among mid-market and channel retail clients. This role owns both the strategic framework connecting Professional Services offerings to Toshiba’s broader growth objectives and the routes to market through which those services reach clients, ensuring services are positioned, packaged, and enabled to accelerate client outcomes and platform stickiness across direct, partner, and alliance-led channels.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 12+ years of experience in professional services, GTM strategy, or related roles, ideally in enterprise software and/or services companies.
  • Experience shaping a services portfolio strategy and defining and managing multi-route GTM models at scale.

About Viam 

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We’re inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We’re a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

Chief of Staff

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to work closely with our founder and CEO as Viam grows.

This role sits at the center of how the company operates. You’ll have visibility into the decisions and information that shape Viam, including company strategy, planning, customers, investors, the board, and new business opportunities.

You’ll work across teams and take on important problems that do not fit neatly within one function. The role comes with a high level of access and trust, and we’re looking for someone who is comfortable getting into the details, challenging assumptions, and owning work without an obvious playbook or existing owner.

This is not an Executive Assistant role. Calendar, travel, and inbox management sit elsewhere.

Founded in 1999, Viking Global Investors (“Viking”) is a global investment firm with a long-term, fundamental, research-intensive approach to investing. Viking manages more than $56 billion of capital across public and private investments. Viking has offices in Stamford, New York, Hong Kong, London, and San Francisco, and is registered as an investment adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. For more information, please visit vikingglobal.com.
